summary: Jerusalem District Court ordered Ben-Gvir to immediately approve Supt. Rinat Saban's promotion, finding his continuing refusal extremely unreasonable and identifying a real and substantial concern of extraneous considerations connected to her role in investigations involving Prime Minister Netanyahu and his advisers.
notes: Accepted narrowly as an administrative-law accountability event. Exact judgment text was recovered through a public court-decision mirror and cross-checked against contemporaneous Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reporting. March 18 enforcement found Ben-Gvir was not acting to comply and set a five-day deadline; Saban was promoted March 24 without his signature, and Supreme Court Justice Alex Stein rejected a stay request. Ben-Gvir's defense and appeal were preserved. This is not a criminal finding, and the recovered Supreme Court action is not treated as a final merits disposition of every appellate issue.
